gudhe.sudhir@gmail.com

+91-9890121297

Flat No 12, A Wing, Neeta Park Housing Society, New Dp Road, Vishal Nagar, Pune-411027

SUMMARY:

Highly accomplished and results-driven Java/J2EE professional with 13+ years of extensive experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable, secure, and high-performance applications. Proven expertise in leading and delivering Microservices architectures with Spring Boot, REST API, gRPC, and GraphQL. Extensive hands-on experience in cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), including Kubernetes and Docker for container orchestration. Adept at the entire SDLC with a strong focus on Agile methodologies and DevOps practices (Jenkins, Argo CD). A strategic problem-solver and collaborative team player, consistently contributing to knowledge management, driving technical excellence, optimizing performance, and driving resilient, secure solutions in high-impact environments.

Technical Skills

Core Competencies: Software Architecture & Design (Microservices, Monolithic, SOA, Cloud- Native Application Development, API Development (RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL), Performance Optimization, Agile/Scrum Methodologies, Quality Assurance & Unit Testing, Production Support & Troubleshooting, Mentorship

Programming Languages: Java (Java 7-21, J2EE), Core Java (Multithreading, Collections, Exception Handling, Streams API, Generics, I/O), SQL

Frameworks: Spring (Spring Core, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security), Hibernate, JPA, Struts, Mockito, JUnit

Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, XML, JSP, JSF, RESTful Web Services, SOAP

Web Application Servers: JBoss, Apache Tomcat, WebLogic

Databases & Tools: Oracle, MySQL, Informix, PostgreSQL, SQL Developer

Cloud Platforms: Google Cloud Platform (GCP - Compute Engine, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage), Amazon Web Services (AWS - EC2, S3)

Operating Systems: MS Windows, Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu)

Version Control & IDEs: Git (GitHub, BitBucket), SVN, VSS, IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, Visual Studio Code

Tools & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, Jenkins, Argo CD, Maven, Gradle, Postman, SoapUI, Putty, Log4j, SLF4J, Prometheus, Grafana

CERTIFICATIONS:

1. Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 11 Developer

2. Associate Cloud Engineer - GCC

3. Cloud Digital Leader – GCC



PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

Zensar Technologies, Atlanta, USA Client Name: Macys Technologies Technical Specialist | Apr 2023 – Present

Spearheaded the end-to-end development of Hazmat compliance microservices using Java 17 and Spring Boot microservices, embedding real-time safety checks and regulatory validations to streamline hazardous material handling and ensure enterprise-grade compliance.

Engineered and optimized robust message queuing solutions utilizing Apache Kafka for high- throughput event streaming and scalable, real-time data processing across distributed systems.

Orchestrated and deployed containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes on GCP, ensuring high availability and scalability.

Managed and optimized CI/CD pipelines with Argo CD for declarative deployments, utilizing a sync process to trigger deployments, which significantly reduced release cycles and improved deployment consistency.

Performed performance tuning and optimization of database queries and application code, improving system response times.

Zensar Technologies, Pune, India

Technical Specialist | Oct 2019 – Apr 2023

Developed Spring Boot microservices with Hibernate ORM for Macy's WMS, including GTP (Goods to Person) functionalities.

Leveraged Core Java (Collections, Multithreading, Streams) and implemented unit tests with

Mockito/JUnit.

Collaborated with business teams on Manhattan WMOS SCPP configurations and managed production code releases.

Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for seamless communication between microservices and external systems.

C3it Solutions, Pune, India
